verdicts.reason: A uses the full height with a strong headline and CTA, but the centered logo clashes with the left-aligned headline, there is a large dead gap between headline and subcopy, and the flavour pills are reversed from the original order and sit at ragged, inconsistent widths and offsets. B packs everything into the top three-quarters and leaves about 150px of empty space at the bottom. Its headline (x≈27) and subcopy/CTA (x≈10) don't share a left edge, the pills form an uneven staircase, and the headline is small and set over overlapping circles.
